name: player-card
title: Player card
description: A squad member for a club site: portrait, shirt number, name, position, nationality and season stats, with injured and suspended players marked in words.
docs: name is the one link of the card (href, with onOpen for a client-side router; without an href but with onOpen it becomes a button). number is set large beside the name and read as 'Number 9'; position is always a word, with an optional positionCode ('FW') drawn as a small tag that is not read. stats are label and value pairs (three or four fit) in a description list with tabular numerals, kept at the foot so a grid of cards lines up whatever each one has, and every card has the same 4:5 portrait. The figures sit in columns once the card is 12.5rem wide (16rem for four) and as rows of label and figure below that, in capitals only from 17rem, and a label that is too long is cut with an ellipsis and never runs into the next figure. A missing photo, or one that fails to load, becomes a tonal tile with the initials. status is fit, injured or suspended: the last two are marked in words in a bar across the photo, 'Injured' or 'Suspended', with returns written as you want it read ('Back around 24 Nov'), and the photo loses some of its colour. In a card narrower than 8.5rem the bar keeps to the word, and the return is still read aloud. captain puts a 'Captain' badge on the photo. nationality and age (read as '24 years') sit under the position. The card answers to its own width, not the screen's: in a column narrower than 12rem the number sits above the name instead of beside it, so a two-column squad grid on a phone still reads. labels carries every word.
